exposure: erythromycin-based antibiotic regimen (erythromycin 250 mg and ampicillin 2 g IV for 48 hours followed by oral amoxicillin 250 mg and erythromycin 333 mg for 5 days)
azithromycin-based antibiotic regimen (azithromycin 1 g PO once)
cohort: Pregnant women between 24 0/7 to 36 0/7 weeks of gestation presenting with Preterm Premature Rupture Of Membranes (PPROM) were included in the study.
finding: There was no statistical difference in latency to delivery between the groups, but the azithromycin group showed a statistically significant lower rate of clinical chorioamnionitis compared to the erythromycin group (33 vs 50 cases, p=0.04).
